evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, `unstartedUnits` entries carry an explicit outcome and `accountPlanned` passes `entry.outcome` into `neverStartedRow`, so budget-exhausted units are no longer forced to `not-started`; the relevant fixes are in the never-run unit outcome commits. The remaining `not-started` labelling for units that never began is not the I9 budget-exhaustion defect alleged.
